top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific invention (magic-wavelength lattice trapping of many neutral atoms) and its realization at the 1e-18 level, with a two-name allocation I can defend name by name, mature and independently reproduced; the Higgs discovery is arguably the larger result, but its three-name attribution remains contested, so P003 (Gianotti, Della Negra, Jenni, my own earlier trio, founding spokespersons plus the discovery-era leader) is second, P002 (Virdee in place of Della Negra) third, and no award last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001-P003; my electron-microscopy and IFSM link concerns B015, which is not on the slate. Kroll's Hall-laboratory tie is his own disclosure.
